name: after-18-inbound-surfaces

marks.name: Inbound channels · the fold the review link opens
marks.why: One agent answers on one channel, so the pick stays two cards. What changed: the two channels Agora cannot serve are named on live rows in the same fold, replacing a grey caption that promised them soon with no date and no door.

name: after-18-channel-sheet-whatsapp

marks.name: What WhatsApp needs, stated in a sheet
marks.why: A channel with no API gets a sheet, not a page, because a page for it could only redirect back here. The row states the dependency and the switch records the ask, so demand is counted at the moment the user asks for it.

name: after-18-inventory-whatsapp-row

marks.name: WhatsApp in the channel inventory
marks.why: Every row derives from the records that exist, so the invented WhatsApp line with its own number, agent and call count cannot reach this page. A channel Agora cannot serve is a readiness state on the surface where you pick it, which no vendor states anywhere.
